Compendium

A glossary of terms from my writing and projects. Select a term for examples, context, and references.

Match any selected tag.

  • Anemoia: Nostalgia for a time you never lived through.

    • Emotions
    • Liminal Spaces
    • Vocabulary

  • The Astley Paradox: An internet joke about asking Rick Astley for the film Up and treating either possible answer as a broken promise from his best-known song.

    • Internet Culture

  • The Backrooms: A fictional maze of seemingly endless rooms and corridors, often entered by slipping out of ordinary reality.

    • Backrooms
    • Horror
    • Internet Folklore
    • Liminal Spaces

  • Boots Theory: Sam Vimes’s idea that people with less money upfront can end up paying more over time because they can only afford goods that need frequent replacement.

    • Economics
    • Literature

  • Byway: A smaller or less-traveled road, often away from a main route.

    • Places
    • Vocabulary

  • Cognitive Bias: A systematic tendency in thinking or judgment that can affect how people interpret information and make decisions.

    • Psychology

  • Cognitive Dissonance: Psychological discomfort associated with holding conflicting beliefs or with acting in a way that conflicts with one’s beliefs.

    • Psychology

  • Cognitive Economy: The use of mental categories or shortcuts to gain useful information while conserving limited attention and effort.

    • Psychology
    • Knowledge

  • Collective Unconscious: Carl Jung’s proposed shared layer of the unconscious, containing inherited patterns he called archetypes.

    • Psychology
    • Storytelling

  • Compendium: A concise collection of information about a subject or a range of subjects.

    • Knowledge
    • Vocabulary

    • Storytelling
